result.stderr:
MetaDataTool is a command-line utility to generate various kinds of metadata
useful when working with the Streaming Integration Platform, Gantry SQL, and
Synergy repositories.

Usage: MetaDataTool <mode> [<arguments>]

Modes:

   help           Show this information.
   isamfdl        Generate ISAM file metadata from FDL files.
   isamfile       Generate ISAM file metadata from a ISAM files.
   keysdl         Generate ISAM file SDL key definition snippets.
   sql            Generate SQL metadata from repository definitions.
   update         Check NuGet.org for a newer version of this tool.
   version        Print version information.

To uninstall: dotnet tool uninstall --global Synergex.MetaDataTool

In isamfdl mode the utility reads one or more OpenVMS FDL files and produces
output files contaiing ISAM metadata.

In isamfile mode the utility reads one or more SDMS ISAM files and produces
output files contaiing ISAM metadata.

In keysdl mode the utility reads a combination of ISAM and Synergy repository
metadata and produces Synergy Data Language (SDL) files containing SDL key
definition snippets that can be added to existing structure definitions.

In sql mode the utility reads one or more FILE definitions from a Synergy
repository and produces output files contaiing SQL metadata.
